benefitRows.offer: Experience exclusive stays at Alaya Stays, offering 4-star villas across 200+ coveted Indian destinations.|Enjoy the special offer of staying for 3 nights and only paying for 2, plus save 50% on the second night.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on movie tickets via BookMyShow, with up to 1 free ticket per month, capped at ₹200.|Additionally, choosing the Food and Beverages option on BookMyShow grants an extra ₹50 off.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
